observation.subject: POST /login
observation.sentence: `POST /login`: warm median 80 ms over 40 requests; all of them reached no handler BootUI marks (an Actuator endpoint, a request the security filters answered, or a servlet outside Spring MVC), so the time is not split into phases. Recorded calls: SQL 2 %, Connection wait 0 %. First request 270 ms (cold).
whatToCheck: Open the slowest exemplar request in Live Activity to see its timeline and recorded calls.
limitations: Some requests ran on virtual threads, whose CPU time and allocation the JVM does not report per thread: Profile resources samples them with JFR.
